input: I'm calibrating the EAS (Energy Aware Scheduling) energy model on a DynamIQ cluster with 4x Cortex-A55 (LITTLE) and 3x Cortex-A710 (big). After running `power_model_calibration.py` with perf-PMU data, the computed capacity values for the A710 cores are 18% lower than what I measure with hardware PMU cycles. The em_perf_domain OPP table looks correct in the device tree, but EAS keeps migrating tasks to LITTLE cores under moderate load. Where in the Linux EAS pipeline — em_cpu_energy, schedutil governor, or the OPP framework — should I focus my investigation?
